officialSkillTexts.name: 断粮
officialSkillTexts.text: 你可以将一张黑色基本牌或黑色装备牌当【兵粮寸断】使用。若你本回合未造成过伤害，你使用【兵粮寸断】无距离限制。

officialSkillTexts.name: 截辎
officialSkillTexts.text: 当一名角色跳过摸牌阶段后，你可以选择一名角色，若其手牌数全场最少且没有“辎”，其获得“辎”标记，否则其摸一张牌。有“辎”的角色于其摸牌阶段结束时移除“辎”，然后执行一个额外的摸牌阶段。

AnyLivingLeastHandCount target facts, attributed markers, DrawPhaseEnded

gaps: No complete generic DrawPhaseSkipped window found. SupplyShortage, old skip programs, new Qiaobian skip, scheduled phases and whole-turn skips need one clearly defined event boundary without duplicating rewards.
InsertPhase currently parses Play only and BeforeNormalPreparation only (ProgramLifecycleOperationDefinitions.cs:105); extra Draw after DrawPhaseEnded is not supported by pure configuration.

Need generic selected-participant least-current-hand/no-marker branch: give Zi when qualifying; otherwise draw1. All living minimum ties, existing marker and actual marker consumption before extra Draw must be frozen at the correct points.

Conditional SupplyShortage distance can likely use turn-reset state plus a fresh policy qualification; RuntimeBooleanState projection/source mapping and damage on inserted phases must be proven. Existing TurnOwnerDamageDealtThisTurn trigger value is restricted to TurnEnding, so it cannot simply be placed into a card policy.
unresolved: Whether a whole skipped face-down turn counts as skipped Draw is not stated by this page; do not invent a trigger for it.
Extra Draw has its own ending window; Zi must be removed before scheduling so repeated insertion cannot loop.
During suppression/reacquisition, issued Zi belongs to the recipient; exact source and continuation ownership require an explicit contract.

officialSkillTexts.name: 肉林
officialSkillTexts.text: 锁定技，你对女性角色使用的【杀】和女性角色对你使用的【杀】均需使用两张【闪】才能抵消。

officialSkillTexts.name: 崩坏
officialSkillTexts.text: 锁定技，结束阶段，若你不是体力值最小的角色，你失去1点体力或减少1点体力上限。

officialSkillTexts.name: 酒池
officialSkillTexts.text: 你可以将一张黑桃手牌当【酒】使用。你使用【酒】无次数限制。当你使用【酒】【杀】造成伤害后，本回合“崩坏”失效。

officialSkillTexts.name: 暴虐
officialSkillTexts.text: 主公技，当其他群势力角色造成1点伤害后，你可以判定，若结果为黑桃，你回复1点体力并获得此判定牌。

gaps: No AlcoholLimit rule query/card policy exists. Normal physical, converted and virtual legal-action paths use UsedPlayPhaseAlcoholThisTurn directly, so unlimited play Alcohol needs one generic qualification used at every existing gate; it must not relax dying Alcohol legality.

Alcohol-boosted Slash damage must carry a frozen consumed-Alcohol flag/provenance on the actual CardUse/attack owning frame. Damage amount2 alone is not proof of Wine Slash because other bonuses also produce2.

Suppress exactly Benghuai for the current actual turn after real boosted Slash damage. Existing current-turn suppression only targets other participants and non-locked skills, so it cannot be reused to disable locked own Benghuai.

Whether an issued Benghuai exemption persists through Jiuchi suppression or a replacement skill instance is an engineering default not stated here.

officialSkillTexts.name: 帷幕
officialSkillTexts.text: 锁定技，你不能成为黑色锦囊牌的目标。你防止回合内受到的伤害并摸所防止伤害值两倍数量的牌。

officialSkillTexts.name: 乱武
officialSkillTexts.text: 限定技，出牌阶段，你可以令所有其他角色依次选择一项：1.对其距离最小的另一名角色使用一张【杀】；2.失去1点体力。所有角色结算完毕后，你可以视为使用一张无距离限制的【杀】。

officialSkillTexts.name: 完杀
officialSkillTexts.text: 锁定技，在你的回合内：只有你和处于濒死状态的角色才能使用【桃】；任意角色的濒死结算中，除你和濒死角色外的其他角色的非锁定技失效。
